title: Cook surface is NOT 12"
text: Cook surface is NOT 12". Hmm... I bought this to replace a so-so quality 12" pan with a 2" side. This one is not better than the one I replaced, AND you should know that this pan may be 12" out the ouside, but the cook surface is about 8"....  My old pan had a 12" cook surface.  Wah.  I am using the $5 rebate as did another buyer.  So I will keep it.  But will need to buy yet another pan. It's worth 3 stars with the rebate!

product_metadata.title: Farberware 21697 High Performance Nonstick Frying Pan / Fry Pan / Skillet - 12 Inch, Black
features: DURABLE FRYING PAN: Nonstick skillet is constructed from durable, fast-heating aluminum
ENHANCED NONSTICK SKILLET: Frying pan features the SmartGlide Nonstick System of durable, top-quality nonstick with a dimpled surface to create air pockets that heat food quickly and evenly
STOVE TO OVEN FRYING PAN: This nonstick skillet is oven safe to 350°F and can go from the cooktop directly into the oven
DISHWASHER SAFE: For fast and easy cleanup, the frying pan is conveniently dishwasher safe
description: The Farberware Dishwasher Safe High Performance Nonstick 12-Inch Frying Pan continues the Farberware tradition with new technology for today’s busy cooks. The frying pan is arguably the handiest tool in the kitchen, and with this 12-Inch skillet, larger recipes are completed with ease. This frying pan features top-quality nonstick coating in the unique SmartGlide Nonstick System, a dimpled surface, improving the nonstick’s durability and creating air pockets that transfer heat to food quickly. The result is a fry pan surface that warms evenly and food that is beautifully browned. The frying pan is oven safe to 350°F and dishwasher safe for swift and simple cleanup. This Farberware Dishwasher Safe High Performance Nonstick 12-Inch Frying Pan is a versatile skillet that busy cooks will reach for morning, noon and night.
